## What is a DataSHIELD Resource

Resources are credential-secured datasets or compute nodes accessed via a URL. In an R/DataSHIELD session, they give analysts secure access to remote big data and high-performance computing.

see <https://opaldoc.obiba.org/en/latest/cookbook/import-data/resources.html#step-3-use-the-resources>.

## Supported Resources

- Base Resources
- OMOP CDM Databases
- ODBC Resources
- S3 buckets

## Example under Base Resource

### Setup a csv file on github as resource

- Login to the server

```{r}
library(DSOpal)
library(dsBaseClient)

# prepare login data and resources to assign
builder <- DSI::newDSLoginBuilder()
builder$append(server = "study1", url = "https://opal-demo.obiba.org",
               user = "dsuser", password = "P@ssw0rd",
               resource = "KIU.KIU-TEST", profile = "default")


logindata <- builder$build()

```

- login and assign resources

```{r}

conns <- datashield.login(logins = logindata, assign = TRUE, symbol = "res")

```

- Examine class of the resource object

```{r}
# assigned objects are of class ResourceClient (and others)
ds.class("res")
```

- coerce ResourceClient objects to data.frames

```{r}

datashield.assign.expr(conns, symbol = "D",
                       expr = quote(as.resource.data.frame(res, strict = TRUE)))
ds.class("D")

```

- List Columns if tabular data

```{r}

ds.colnames("D")
```

- do usual dsBase analysis

```{r}

#Gender Proportions

```

```{r}
#Race Distribution

```

### Additional exercise with resources

- login to servers

```{r}
library(DSOpal)
library(dsBaseClient)

# prepare login data and resources to assign
builder <- DSI::newDSLoginBuilder()
builder$append(server = "study1", url = "https://opal-demo.obiba.org",
               user = "dsuser", password = "P@ssw0rd",
               resource = "RSRC.CNSIM1", profile = "default")
builder$append(server = "study2", url = "https://opal.isglobal.org/repo",
               user = "invited", password = "12345678Aa@",
               resource = "CNSIM.CNSIM2", profile = "rock-inma")

logindata <- builder$build()
```

```{r}
# login and assign resources
conns <- datashield.login(logins = logindata, assign = TRUE, symbol = "res")
```

```{r}
# assigned objects are of class ResourceClient (and others)
ds.class("res")

```

```{r}
# coerce ResourceClient objects to data.frames
# (DataSHIELD config allows as.resource.data.frame() assignment function for the purpose of the demo)
datashield.assign.expr(conns, symbol = "D",
                       expr = quote(as.resource.data.frame(res, strict = TRUE)))
ds.class("D")
```


```{r}
ds.colnames("D")

```

- do usual dsBase analysis

```{r}

ds.summary('D$LAB_HDL')

# vector types are not necessarily the same depending on the data reader that was used
ds.class('D$GENDER')
ds.asFactor('D$GENDER', 'GENDER')
ds.summary('GENDER')

```

```{r}
mod <- ds.glm("DIS_DIAB ~ LAB_TRIG + GENDER", data = "D" , family="binomial")
mod$coeff

```

```{r}
datashield.logout(conns)
```
